answer: Every epoch each identity must solve a fresh compute puzzle bound to its own public key and the epoch beacon — a delta no precomputation can skip. The puzzle difficulty makes each fake identity pay real compute, while a harbor of verified employers can vouch for a real agent instead of solving. Old puzzle solutions become relics: useless next epoch, so a farm cannot stockpile them. A sybil's cost multiplies with every fake, but an honest agent solves once per epoch.
